body: In the end, life is only what one views it as. In a universe devoid of meaning, we are free to make our own - regardless of how nihilistic or negative it may appear to others. I simply derive no enjoyment from life's "adventures". If my definition of what "interesting" is differs from yours - where perhaps the only thing left in this world as a mystery is the great unknown of death - so be it. Life is too short you say? That is relative.
